title: Market Intelligence & Sentiment Validation
acceptance_criteria: Trace the real pipeline from source, through market/ETF relevance, sentiment, impact, to summary, and clearly distinguish deterministic computation from AI-generated content.
Keep bullish/bearish signals actionable; handle neutral separately and never force a direction when none is warranted.
Do not conflate confidence, impact, and relevance as if they were the same measurement.
Affected-market/ETF mapping must be evidence-based, not generic US-keyword certainty; explicitly show limitations for Taiwan, UK, and other non-US/global coverage.
If no independent labeled ground truth exists, explicitly state that the pipeline is not externally validated and do not fabricate precision/recall/F1 metrics.
Only show source and as-of metadata when it is actually available.
Add methodology/validation UI and deterministic automated tests covering the above.
prohibited: No ETF application/business-logic changes outside of this task's methodology and disclosure scope.
Do not fabricate validation metrics that are not backed by real labeled data.
